title: rosa glauca subvar. intricata
intro: Rosa glauca subvar. intricata, commonly known as the Alpenrose, is a variety of shrub-like rose plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is a rich source of bioactive compounds that have been traditionally used to support various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin conditions, reduce stress, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in Rosa glauca subvar. intricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential therapeutic benefits, including wound healing, skin conditions, and stress relief.
